services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: On this page, you can find information about field trips, scavenger hunt downloads, and Frequently Asked Questions. A visit to the Tennessee State Museum and Capitol is free. However, you must reserve a specific date and time through the museum’s scheduling office AND obtain a confirmation letter from the museum. On a guided tour of the Tennessee State Capitol, educators will lead your group in an exploration of the functions of state and local government, the history of the state of Tennessee, and interesting stories about the building itself.
